purpose: Separate meeting-domain transfer check; not pooled with primary UniTalk screen
selection: Earliest target segment >=1.4s, and earliest other-speaker segment >=1.4s with no overlapping target speech. Start segment+0.2s rounded up to video frame grid; one second each.
labels: Published transcript segment proxy for activity, not independently annotated dense visual speaking labels
crop: Fixed manually reviewed box [130,100,270,245] on original Closeup1 frames, shared across both segments and all variants
input_only_amendment: Haar failed on a selected first frame. Before any AMI model inference, inspected both original first frames and fixed a common face box. No segments changed; hand occlusion on the silent segment retained.
claim_limit: One meeting, two segments, descriptive domain transfer; no ASR evaluation, no full conversation agent, no independent replication count beyond one meeting
